cards.title: Unfollow on TikTok: **one tap, no alert**
cards.sub: Tap Following on their profile or in your list. There’s no unfollow-all button, so pace it.

steps.title: Your Following list
steps.text: Tap the button by their name.

steps.title: Big list?
steps.text: Batches of a few dozen, with breaks.

cards.title: Gentle fixes, and **what gets you limited**
